items.why: security brain asks for it

items.what: Chart pages: the slowest 10% of real loads take 13s — phones 2.43s vs desktop 9.66s (44% of loads on phones); the server answers in 0.21s and candles in 0.05s (HIT) — the time is on the visitor's side. NETWORK, not device: US loads 0.96s at p90, the slow 10% are far/slow connections — IN 16s ×71, IR 38s ×16, PK 12s ×24, JP 8.2s ×15. The lever is first-load weight (a lighter first chart bundle / fewer candles on slow links), a build session. A headless flood is on (US: 201 raw vs ~12.4, 2 stayed, GB: 87 raw vs ~6.5, 0 stayed) — its loads pollute the desktop number; trust phones until it stops. Most slow-load time sits in: desktop/IN 20s ×50, desktop/IR 47s ×10, desktop/US 1.81s ×218, mobile/PK 16s ×13.
items.why: speed brain asks for it
